title: Reading Union Fields
goal: Access a union field inside an unsafe block.
hints: Unions store no type tag, so reading any field requires an unsafe block.
Select the field that holds the full integer value rather than just one byte.
explanation: Reading a field from a union requires `unsafe` because Rust cannot verify that the memory matches that field's type. Omission of `unsafe` triggers compiler error `E0133`. Accessing `val()` fails with `E0599` because fields are not methods. Choosing `raw[0] as u32` compiles inside `unsafe` but fails the test by returning only the first byte instead of the complete integer.
